newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NBP sets December reserve money target.
newsitem.headline: Polish NBP sets December reserve money target.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland set December's reserve money target band between 34.43 and 35.13 billion zlotys, the central bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
In November, the target band was set between 33.29 and 33.99 billion zlotys.
The average level of reserve money in October was 33.00 billion zlotys, within the target of 32.95 to 33.65 billion.
November's average reserve level is expected to be released at the end of December.
Reserve money, also called high powered money or monetary base, consists of cash in circulation, cash in vaults and obligatory reserves.
Since January 1996, it has served as the central bank's monetary policy operational target, through which it wants to control money supply growth and inflation.
